method: Surface distance and corresponding-point displacement of outer garment vertices to the coherently body-deformed reference cage. These assets have one clothed mesh, not a separate hidden nude torso: the pre-slim clothed body is the reference surface. The reference uses authored bone influences throughout; no spatial arm reclassification. Skin/head/hand/weapon/cap vertices are excluded. Both offsets must be <=10 mm. Visual crops remain required: this check alone cannot prove bag shape or cloth fold quality.
